expanded_prompts.default: Create one completely original friendly fantasy creature as a full-body game character illustration on true transparent alpha, no scene or text. Rounded clear dark outline, soft clean cel shading, a calm cute face. The neutral grey structure guide only specifies counts and placement: five equal-width short rounded cylindrical body segments connected in a shallow S curve, first right segment contains exactly two eyes and is slightly raised. The head IS the first segment, so the total is five, with no extra head or neck. Zero legs, arms or wings. One short blunt tail continues directly from the fifth rear segment and is no longer than one body width. Each of the five segments has two thick rounded-square scale plates, one on each physical side, ten total; show their raised square corners clearly. Body scales are tidy overlapping rounded squares, not fish petals. Primary muted tan #C9A995, secondary pale mint #D6E1BD, dark outline #5E6178. Preserve the segment count and side plate count. Orient gently to the right at three-quarter view with enough elevated angle to read both side plates. Full body contained with generous transparent margins. Do not reproduce the grey guide artwork or labels. No lettering, props, cast shadow, scenery, border, signature or logos.
expanded_prompts.pixel: Draw a new original pixel-art sprite of the SAME friendly fantasy creature in the provided approved character image, using it as the direct identity reference. This is a separate hand-designed pixel interpretation on a128 by128 logical grid, not a downscaled illustration. Five short equal-width cylindrical segments including the face segment, joined in a shallow S. Exactly two eyes on the first rightmost segment; no feet, arms or wings. Ten big rounded-square side scale plates, two per segment. One very short blunt rear tail. Preserve the same soft tan, pale mint and dark purple colors, right facing pose and segment contour. Hard crisp pixel staircase outlines, simple small flat-color clusters, at most32 visible colors, no smoothing or dithering. True transparent background and a fully contained whole character with at least8 logical pixels of margin. No letters or extra objects.

Reference is project own scaled001 STYLE ONLY: same clean handdrawn darkcontour, restrained3-stepcelshading, softupperleftlight. Do not copy reference silhouette/anatomy/palette/face or plates.
